meshSurgeryReason: 2026-10-12 lane A (standing mesh-surgery approval; send-back 'fists welded to the belly is a mesh defect'): Meshy modelled the crossed forearms and fists as part of the whirlwind torso's front wall and the upper-arm puffs as part of its sides, with no torso surface behind them, so any arm raise tore a sheet off the belly (a fist-only limb_cut left the forearms welded). limb_shell_surgery.py duplicates each arm's faces (arm-chain skin share > 0.5 in the delivery base, above z 0.95) into a free shell and pulls the original faces in to close the torso wall under them; every face, UV and texel is kept, and at rest the arms cover the wall exactly as before. The wall and arm shells are re-skinned in the glbPatch (setWeights). s5 (coordinator option b) relocates the left fist copy island from the belly onto the elbow end of the left upper-arm puff (--relocate artifacts/homm3_mesh_surgery/h3_hurricane_elemental_fist_relocate.json) so the raised arm carries it.

glbPatch.reason: DEF g12 AttackFront: with the arms cut free of the torso wall (limb_shell surgery), both arms are thrown up overhead on the wind-up (f0-f1, body rearing back), then the body lunges deeper and lower toward the target (f2-f3) with both arms driven forward; idle-family clips turn the left upper arm 40 deg inward and forward so the relocated left fist (s5) crosses in front of the belly
